title: OrionDB product overview
content: OrionDB is the company's managed analytics database. It supports SQL dashboards, batch imports, audit logs, and role-based access control. The public launch target is Q3.

title: Employee benefits summary
content: Employees receive health insurance, a 401k match, parental leave, and an annual learning stipend. The public HR page says benefits begin on the first day of employment.

title: Security overview for customers
content: Customer data is encrypted at rest and in transit. The platform supports single sign-on, audit logging, and quarterly access reviews.

title: Internal support escalation guide
content: For OrionDB support escalations, contact Priya Shah at priya.shah@examplecorp.com or call 415-555-0199. Public response time for enterprise tickets is four hours.

title: Internal incident retrospective
content: The May incident was caused by a stale cache key. The customer-facing fix was to rotate cache nodes and add a regression test. Internal owner email: incident-owner@examplecorp.com.
